description: LedgerLens test criticality taxonomy. Maps test file/node-id patterns to CRITICAL, HIGH, or LOW. CRITICAL and HIGH failures block the release gate; LOW is informational only. Patterns use fnmatch glob rules against the pytest node ID.

entries.reason: Core Benford scoring path — chi-square, Z-score, MAD. Any failure here means risk scores are unreliable.
Benford conformity interval tests — regression here breaks fraud detection thresholds.
Feature engineering produces the model input matrix. Silent errors here corrupt every downstream score.
BFT ensemble voting and RiskScorer — the final scoring output consumed by the API and Soroban contract.
Model training pipeline — ensures trained artifacts are valid and reproducible.
SQLAlchemy persistence layer — failures here mean scored wallets are not stored correctly.
Dry-run safety contract — --dry-run must never write to DB or on-chain.
Config validation — bad config silently corrupts the pipeline at runtime.
SHAP explainability — required for auditable scores but not on the direct scoring hot path.
Wallet graph features — funding-graph similarity and ring detection.
Advanced ring detection edge cases.
Feature drift detection — PSI-based retraining triggers.
Automated retraining pipeline — promotion gate and exit codes.
Cross-venue coordination features — SDEX + AMM wash-trade signal.
Cross-asset coordination features.
Alert delivery — dedup and dispatch correctness.
Soroban contract client — on-chain score submission.
Adversarial robustness — FGSM/PGD evasion attack coverage.
Differential-privacy SHAP — privacy budget enforcement.
Ensemble calibration — NSGA-II Pareto front correctness.
Conformal prediction intervals — uncertainty quantification.
Order-book event ingestion — cancellation rate feature.
Streaming pipeline backend routing.
Idempotency guarantees — double-writes corrupt the risk-score store.
Partial-run recovery — failures here mean crashed pipelines corrupt data on restart.
Release gate itself — meta-test ensuring the gate logic is correct.
Engineering quality scorecard — ensures metric collection is accurate.
Historical backtesting — slow and data-dependent; informational only.
Federated learning — experimental; not on the production scoring path.
Async federated learning — experimental.
GNN encoder — embedding generation for future use.
Live integration tests — require external services; not run in standard CI.
